title: Additional construction standards for vertical above-ground cylindrical tanks outside of buildings exceeding 6 gallons
officialText: (23 L). Vertical above-ground cylindrical storage tanks exceeding 6 gallons (23 L) that are located outside of buildings shall comply with the requirements of Sections 1305.14.5.1 through 1305.14.5.3.
